### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **6** package(s): `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server`, `@objectstack/http-conformance`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/service-storage`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **43** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **8** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/package.json`, `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/index.ts`, `packages/qa/http-conformance/vitest.config.ts`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**18** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c1e6cf75a757a7e9102bae608ddb020135619882`.

⛔ **7** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **8** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/package.json`, `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/index.ts`, `packages/qa/http-conformance/vitest.config.ts`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `/api/v1 (route, 128 pages)`
- **14** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **68** of **251** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **185** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c1e6cf75a757a7e9102bae608ddb020135619882` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `f8ae870606a22694409b39de5a7be58910ec2ec3` — the merge of head `8163e388bfd40b203f04433aa8038a680d64b03b` into base `c1e6cf75a757a7e9102bae608ddb020135619882`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin f8ae870606a22694409b39de5a7be58910ec2ec3 && git checkout f8ae870606a22694409b39de5a7be58910ec2ec3
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin c1e6cf75a757a7e9102bae608ddb020135619882 8163e388bfd40b203f04433aa8038a680d64b03b && git checkout -B drift-repro c1e6cf75a757a7e9102bae608ddb020135619882 && git merge --no-ff 8163e388bfd40b203f04433aa8038a680d64b03b

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c1e6cf75a757a7e9102bae608ddb020135619882
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs c1e6cf75a757a7e9102bae608ddb020135619882` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `0e6be1a2506e4a57895cc6cbf0b94db2e5ce9b5d`
Local-runs: none
Scope: all 37 paths of `git diff 6a731859de..0e6be1a250` (merge base with `origin/main`) + card #36506 and its comments 7081412453, 7097905516, 7100098053; ruling 6079645593 on #22438; card #36469; PR #36539 file list; the PR body; `packages/runtime/src/domains/comments.ts`, `approvals.ts`, `webhooks.ts`; `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts` (`resolveService`, `requestKernel`, `getRequestKernelService`); `packages/runtime/src/domain-handler-registry.ts`; `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/comment-doors-member.ts` and `package.json`; `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/adapter.ts` and `package.json`; `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/personal-view-routes.ts`; `packages/core/src/security/own-row-delete-routes.ts`; `packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-service-plugin.ts` (`mountAttachmentRemovalDoor`); `packages/adapters/hono/src/index.ts` (catch-all body read); `packages/qa/dogfood/test/route-ledger-live-mount-parity.dogfood.test.ts`; `packages/qa/http-conformance/src/` listing; `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`; check-runs of the head
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: none

### ① Derived judgments

- The published surface is what the PR declares. Spec gains `IAttachmentDoorsService` and `IPersonalViewDoorsService`, the `personal-views` key in `ServiceSlotContracts`, and two barrel lines. plugin-hono-server gains `createDoorTableMember`, `matchDoorTableRoute` and the type `DoorTableRoute`. Runtime gains two domains and three ledger rows. Nothing is removed or renamed.
- Every addition is additive and optional. Each contract has one optional member, `(request: Request) => Promise<Response>`. The type pins assert optionality, the one-`Request` parameter list, the `Promise<Response>` return and the barrel identity.
- The contract shape equals #36539's `ICommentDoorsService.handleCommentDoor`. The member body equals plugin-audit's `createCommentDoorMember`, generalised into plugin-hono-server. The bridge body equals `comments.ts` line for line, except the slot lookup (see the note below).
- The baselines are right. `api-surface/contracts.json` and `export-origins/contracts.json` each gain exactly the two interfaces, in sorted position, with the correct origin files. #36539 moved the same two files and no other.
- The route census (153 to 156) matches the three new rows. The matrix arithmetic holds: 44 keys, 20 classified, 24 in the baseline.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is true. `Metadata-protocol: none` is true: no authorable schema, no `authorable-surface` or `authorable-defaults` baseline moves.
- **should-fix (false in-tree statement, and the proof it names is missing).** `packages/runtime/src/domains/own-door-bridge.test.ts` line 30 to 32 says the wire half "is `packages/qa/http-conformance/src/hono-own-row-doors.conformance.test.ts`". That file does not exist at this head. The matrix row `own-row-doors-session` also says "Unit-, wire- and dogfood-proven", and no wire test is in the diff. #36539 shipped its wire half (`hono-comment-doors.conformance.test.ts`: `createHonoApp`, the real plugin, a kernel with no `http.server`). Without it, no test drives the personal-view door to an authorised 200 on a kernel composed with `registerRoutes: false` and no `http.server`. The `[hosted]` dogfood cases run the dispatcher over a self-hosted stack, and the plugin-auth member test pins only the anonymous 401 and the 404. Fix: add the conformance file as the precedent did, or delete the citation and the word "wire-" and state the gap.
- note: `file-attachments` is still absent from `ServiceSlotContracts`, so `IAttachmentDoorsService` is not tied to its slot in the type ledger. The bridge also names members as strings and imports no spec type, where `comments.ts` imports `ICommentDoorsService`. A renamed spec member would not fail the runtime typecheck. Tests on the real stack would catch it.
- note: plugin-audit keeps its own copy of the table member. Folding it onto `createDoorTableMember` is a follow-up, not this PR.

### ② Semver level

- The changeset grades `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, `@objectstack/service-storage` and `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` at `patch`. Those are all five published packages whose source moves. `@objectstack/dogfood` is private.
- `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` requires every entry to be `patch` under `Metadata-protocol: none`, and forbids `major`. The changeset meets both. It carries both declaration lines, equal to the PR body. The `Check Changeset` run is green on this head.
- `patch` for a `Clause-②` widening follows the #36539 precedent (same declaration, same level).

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Same authorization, no bypass.** Each member runs the plugin's own registrar (`registerPersonalViewRoutes`, `mountAttachmentRemovalDoor`) over the same deps as the self-hosted mount. `personalViewDoorDeps()` is one function used by both faces. `attachment-removal-routes.ts` and `own-row-delete-routes.ts` are not in the diff. So the caller resolution, the read as the caller, the owner check, the attachment update gate and the order of refusals are unchanged code.
- **Principal and context.** The bridge passes only the transport's `Request`. It builds no `ExecutionContext` and adds no credential. The member resolves the caller from the request headers through the request kernel's own registry (`this.authManager`, `toGateRegistry(ctx)`). The system write inside the door runs only after the own-row checks, as before. No system context can enter from the bridge.
- **Request kernel only.** The bridge reads the slot with `getRequestKernelService`, which has no host fallback. A test pins that a tenant kernel without the member gets 501 and the host's member is never called.
- **501 when absent.** Correct and typed. The message names the slot and the registering package only. It carries no tenant data. It matches the precedent's wording class.
- **Preamble gates.** No allow-list entry and no membership skip is added. Tests pin a non-member 403 and an owed-step stop before the member runs, with a positive control.
- **The private table cannot listen.** `new HonoHttpServer(0)` only builds a Hono app; listening is a separate call that nothing here makes. The table is never registered as a service, so it cannot become `http.server`. This is the same construction plugin-audit already ships.
- **Route-envelope parity.** `check-route-envelope.mjs` gains three `handBuilt: 0` rows. That is true: every bridge answer goes through `deps.routeNotFound` or `deps.error`, and the member's `Response` is returned untouched.
- **Dogfood matrix.** A strengthening. Two new domains arrive classified by a new `enforced` row. The baseline file changes one comment only (+3 -2); no key is added to the unclassified baseline. Not marking it HIGH_RISK follows the `comment-doors-session` precedent.
- **No test gets weaker.** Test files are add-only except three changed lines in the storage integration fixture, which add an opt-out flag and return one more field. `core-service-contracts.test.ts` moves the exact slot list from 8 to 9.
- **Dependency.** plugin-hono-server depends on core, observability, spec and types only, so no cycle forms. plugin-audit already has the same runtime dependency. The pull is `hono` and `@hono/node-server` at module load; the table itself is built on first request.
- **Pins red without the fix.** The PR body records three ablations with counts and a proved restore. They were not re-run here.
- note: a security item is with the owner seat.
- note: the attachment member captures the `objectql` engine when the table is first built. A null read at that moment would be kept for the life of the process. The self-hosted mount captures at `kernel:ready` in the same way, so this is parity, and a first request comes after bootstrap.
- note: `mountAttachmentRemovalDoor` logs "attachment removal door mounted" on the first hosted request, on a kernel that has no server.
- note: at review time the PR is a draft, most CI jobs are still running, and the dogfood shards are skipped.

### ④ Design judgment

- The design is ruling A applied per member, as the card asks: an optional transport-neutral member on the producer's contract, an exact dispatcher domain, a typed 501 on an absent slot, and the self-hosted mount unchanged.
- A separate `personal-views` slot and reuse of `file-attachments` are both sound. The changeset states the new duplicate-name risk for `personal-views`.
- One shared bridge and one shared table member reduce copies. That is better than a third hand-written domain.
- The claim amendment explains the wider surface and the `Clause-②` change from `no` to `yes`. Cloud needs no change, as with #36469.
- One should-fix is open: the missing wire-half test that the tree cites as existing.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8163e388bfd40b203f04433aa8038a680d64b03b`
Local-runs: none
Scope: the delta `git diff 0e6be1a250..8163e388bf` (4 paths: `packages/qa/http-conformance/package.json`, `packages/qa/http-conformance/src/hono-own-row-doors.conformance.test.ts`, `packages/qa/http-conformance/vitest.config.ts`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`) + the PR body at the new head; `packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-conformance.matrix.ts` and `packages/runtime/src/domains/own-door-bridge.test.ts` at the new head; check-runs of the new head. The first-round record (head `0e6be1a250`) stands for the other 37 paths, which the delta does not touch.
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: none

### ① Derived judgments

- The delta is test-only. No published source, no spec file, no baseline and no changeset moves. The first round's judgments on surface, optionality, precedent shape and baselines stand unchanged.
- **The round-one should-fix is closed.** `hono-own-row-doors.conformance.test.ts` now exists, so the citation in `own-door-bridge.test.ts` resolves, and the matrix row's "wire-proven" is true.
- The wire test goes through the hosted dispatcher path. The hosted boot composes no `HonoServerPlugin`, runs `AuthPlugin` with `registerRoutes: false`, asserts `http.server` is undefined, and sends every request through `createHonoApp` with `app.request`. The sign-up and sign-in go through the same door.
- It asserts store effects, read from the engine under a system context. The owner's personal-view delete: 200 and the row is gone. Another member: 404 `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` and the row stays with its owner. Anonymous: 401 and the row stays. Attachment rename: 200, trimmed name in the store. Attachment removal: 200 and the row is gone.
- Byte parity is real: four refusals are compared between the hosted door and a self-hosted boot over a real socket, status, headers and body.
- A hosted kernel without storage answers 501 `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` naming the package.
- The PR body at the new head lists the file, its seven tests and three ablations for it. Both declaration lines are unchanged and still true.
- note: the matrix row's note says "wire-" but does not name the new file. Naming it would make the row self-checking.
- note: the wire file has no "another member 403" case for attachments. The dogfood `[hosted]` case and the storage integration file pin it.
- note: the 501 case covers the attachment doors only. The personal-view 501 is pinned in `own-door-bridge.test.ts`.

### ② Semver level

- Unchanged. The delta adds no changeset entry and needs none: `@objectstack/http-conformance` is `private: true`.
- The four new workspace entries sit in that private package's `devDependencies`. The lockfile gains only those four links under that importer. Nothing leaks into a published package.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The new vitest aliases are anchored (`^...$`) and live in the private package's config. They point `service-storage`, `platform-objects/plugin`, `plugin-security` and `plugin-sharing` at this checkout's source, so the verdict is about this tree.
- note: `@objectstack/runtime` is not aliased to source in that config, so the wire file reads the dispatcher from the built `dist`. The PR body says so for its ablation. CI builds before it tests.
- No test is weakened. The delta is add-only.
- The credentials in the wire test are real sessions. No system context reaches a door; system context is used only to read the store for assertions and to seed one file row.
- The red-before counts (7 of 7, 4, 4) are the PR body's record. They were not re-run here.
- note: at review time the PR is a draft, and CI on the new head is still running (2 green, 19 in progress, none failed).
- A security item is with the owner seat.

### ④ Design judgment

- The rework is the fix the first round asked for, in the precedent's shape (#36539's `hono-comment-doors.conformance.test.ts`). It proves the card's hosted composition end to end, which the first head did not.
- No must-fix and no should-fix is open.

## 维护者速读
云端（托管）环境里，「删除自己保存的个人视图」以及附件的「删除、改名」点了以后会报找不到接口。这次修好了，和自建环境的行为、权限完全一致：本人能操作；别人删不了；没登录的人会被拒绝。
合同级复核两轮通过，CI 全绿，席位落地。云端要等 cloud 的平台版本前移到这次修改之后才会生效。
要你做的：无。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1) · repo:objectstack#1 · head `8163e388` · 2026-11-23T12:45Z

- **Shape:** `Fixes #36506`. This follows ruling A on #22438 (6079645593), in the same shape as #36539: two optional spec service contracts (attachment doors, personal-view doors), a `personal-views` slot, two runtime dispatcher domains with a request-kernel-only bridge, plugin-hono-server's private door-table member, the plugin-auth and service-storage members, dogfood and wire conformance pins, and patch changesets. Not governed: 0 of 37+ paths.
- **Contract review:** CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER, widening face. Round 1 (7100200457, at `0e6be1a2`) was a FAIL: the cited wire half was missing. Round 2 (7100532871, at this head) is a PASS.
  - `hono-own-row-doors.conformance.test.ts` drives the hosted path with no `http.server`, using real sessions. The owner gets 200 and the row is gone. Another member gets 404 and anonymous gets 401, and the row stays. Rename and then remove on the uploader's own attachment both answer 200, and the store follows. The refusals are byte-identical to the self-hosted mount. A kernel with no storage gets a 501 that names it.
  - The surface is exactly as declared and is all additive. All five moved packages are graded `patch`. A security item is with the owner seat.
- **Evidence (thread):** with the domains deleted, 7 of 7 wire tests are red with the pre-fix 404; 4 more go red per ablation. runtime 11872, plugin-auth 6268, storage 1729 and hono-server 585 pass; http-conformance 22 files / 305 tests pass. Dogfood is 37/37. Six typechecks pass.
- **Gates:** 73 check-runs on `8163e388`: 62 success, 11 skipped, 0 failed. K = 8 first-parent commits behind main (< 15).
- **Landing:** ready + auto-merge now. On merge, #36506 closes and the seat clears its label. Hosted delivery needs cloud's framework pin to move past this merge, as with #36469.
